name: @letbuyy/lcis-rootcause
description: LRAS — Root Cause Analysis System. Read-only, deterministic diagnosis intelligence: symptom → ranked cause hypotheses with evidence + confidence, affected systems (via the dependency twin), recent changes (via change tracking), likely owner, recommended rollback and verification plan. Never hallucinates — every hypothesis carries evidence or is dropped; no signal → verdict UNKNOWN with the missing signals named.
